Name: Quick Riposte
Description: If unit’s HP is 80% or more and foe initiates combat, unit will always follow up (if weapon allows).

Description: If foe initiates combat, grants Def/Res+30% during combat. [Dragon] Ddg+50%. [Cavalry] Grants immunity to freeze. [Armored] Grants Def+50% instead of +30%. [Flying] Grants Res+50% instead of +30%.

Name: Storm’s Eye+
Description: Grants immunity to break. Foe cannot follow up. Unit counters before foe’s first attack and follows up. Lasts 1 turn. Sword/axe only. [Dragon] Prevent one critical hit. [Backup] Crit+20. [Covert] Avo+30.
